scope.analysis_scope: Custom — Sunday games kicking off before 2:00 p.m. ET
scope.kickoff_rule: Include Sunday games with scheduled kickoff strictly earlier than 2:00 p.m. ET

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent completed regular-season games per player before the cutoff

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 5
historical_cutoff.game: Buffalo Bills at Los Angeles Rams

draftkings_fallback_check.note: FanDuel alternate-market data is available for the locked Stage 1 shortlist; DraftKings was not substituted.

alternate_band_rule.core: Use FanDuel alternate Over price in the inclusive -350 to -150 band; choose price numerically closest to -250; ties choose the more negative price.
alternate_band_rule.floor: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than CORE.
alternate_band_rule.ceiling: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than CORE, regardless of its historical hit rate.
alternate_band_rule.historical_hr: Hits are observations >= alternate threshold divided by the exact locked Stage 1 L10 denominator; no historical sample reconstruction.
alternate_band_rule.candidate_narrowing: Carry records with a CORE and at least one selected Floor/Core/Ceiling threshold with historical HR >=70%, matching the final-leg minimum. Exclude records with no matching alternates, no qualifying CORE, or no selected band meeting 70%.
